items.title: File Widerspruch against tree-felling refusal
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Musterbek, Musterbeker Markt 4, 22297 Hamburg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 30.04.2026, sent by post; deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting per § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (in conjunction with HmbVwVfG). Counting 3 days after 30.04.2026 (i.e. 01.05., 02.05., 03.05.2026) lands on Sunday 03.05.2026. Since § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG applies analogously to this fiction period and the 3rd day falls on a Sunday, delivery is deemed to occur on the next working day, Monday 04.05.2026 (01.05.2026 being the Tag der Arbeit holiday does not shift this further as it falls before the 3rd-day count, and 02.-03.05. are Sat/Sun). One-month Widerspruch period runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe: 04.06.2026 (Thursday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or Hamburg public holiday, so no further shift applies.
